theme_and_archetype.description: A luxury beauty brand aesthetic emphasizing warmth, elegance, and bespoke quality. High-end editorial feel using generous spacing, elegant serif typography, and a cream/beige palette.

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, Editorial quotes, Brand Name. Use tracking-tight for large sizes.

body.usage: Paragraphs, UI elements, labels, buttons. Clean and legible.

monogram.style: MH - Use elegant thin weight or standard serif for the logo mark.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24 for section paddings. Ensure elements breathe.
layout_and_spacing.container: Max-width 6xl (max-w-6xl) centered for the main content.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Center-align hero and headers to reinforce editorial symmetry, left-align paragraph content where readability demands it.

buttons.primary: Black pill shape (rounded-full), white text, no shadow, subtle hover state (bg-zinc-800).

inputs.style: Minimalist. Either underline style (border-b only) or very subtle rounded-md with border-border. Use Shadcn customized.

cards.style: Soft beige/off-white (bg-[#FDFBF7]), subtle 1px border (border-[#E5DCCF]), large padding (p-8 to p-12). No harsh shadows, just very diffuse ambient shadow if necessary (shadow-sm).

hero_bottles.description: Three cream cosmetic bottles ('The Veil', 'The Hue', 'The Finish') for the Hero Section.

lifestyle_portrait.description: Lifestyle portrait of a woman with elegant brown hair for 'The Maison Hue Story' section.

hair_swatches.description: Hair color swatches image for the 'Reserve Your Shade' section.

story.heading: Rooted in you.
story.copy: Placeholder for brand story (emphasizing bespoke, high-end care).

instructions_to_main_agent: REPLICATE EXACTLY: Use cream/beige #F5EFE6 palette across the page layout.
TYPOGRAPHY: Import 'Playfair Display' from Google Fonts for all headings and 'Outfit' (or generic sans-serif) for body text.
BRANDING: Use the text 'MH' in Playfair Display as the monogram logo.
BUTTONS: Must be black pill shapes (rounded-full bg-black text-white) with no shadows.
TESTING: Add 'data-testid' attributes to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, forms) using kebab-case.
MEDIA: Use the provided media_urls strictly. Do not use generic placeholders.
LAYOUT: Apply generous padding. Group the three feature items inside a soft beige card.
